input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms that declining to place further Order Forms is neither a breach nor a shortfall, so fees are payable only for Services actually ordered — the preferred position. Section 7.1 further bars any unidentified minimum-use or similar charge, and § 12.3 records that we have made no minimum-volume commitment. No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty or volume cap on our usage appears anywhere in the document, so no redline is needed.
